title: Mini-case: Maison Brot
text: Maison Brot is a chain of 12 bakeries in Munich. It owns a 60-year-old sourdough culture and a recipe know-how passed on by its master bakers, trains its own apprentices, has a beloved local brand and good shop locations, and recently bought new ovens that any competitor can buy.

title: Mini-case: an online glasses retailer
text: An online glasses retailer designs its frames in-house, buys lenses from a large supplier, cuts and assembles glasses in its own lab, ships within 48 hours, offers free home try-on of five frames and a 30-day return policy, and runs strong social-media marketing.

title: Mini-case: Kodak-style photo company
text: A photo company dominated film photography with world-class chemistry know-how, a strong brand and global retail distribution. Digital cameras and later smartphones made film obsolete within a decade.
